content.comment_body: Hello, I recently purchased a [company_name] [product_name] starter kit. After installing [product_name], the software always displays "Demoversion" at the top. Is the version included with the starter kit only a demo? My connection to the [product_name] using its IP seems fine. How can I obtain the full version? Thank you, [user_name].

Hello, that's not possible—the software should be a full version. Try uninstalling, rebooting your PC, and reinstalling. Make sure to keep the installation disc in the drive during setup. This approach should work. Regards, [user_name].
The challenge is that my PC doesn't have a DVD/CD drive. I copied the entire disc from a network DVD drive to my computer—maybe that's causing the issue? Any tips on how to remove the "Demo" prompt?

I've experienced a similar problem. Using an external USB CD/DVD drive resolved it for me, or you could create an image of the original DVD and mount it using appropriate software before installing. Regards, [user_name].
Hello, it's possible that [company_name] now provides a license for [product_name] differently than before. Instead of the usual automation license manager, they offer licensing by other means.

Hi, try this method: Copy the [product_name] DVD to your PC using any method. Browse to the Windows folder from your copy and run setup.bat. Note: Only systems up to Windows 7 are supported, not Windows 8. The installer will detect your Windows version (32/64 bit) and install accordingly. If that doesn't help, you can try running [product_name] directly without installation. Go to the Windows folder of the copied DVD, then to your system's 32/64 bit folder and execute the application file. Hope this helps.
This suggestion might be useful—I'll try it myself as well.

As mentioned earlier, I copied the CD to my local drive. Running the software directly from the copied CD without installing still results in the "Demoversion" message. Is there anything else I can try?

Hello, you might want to contact the seller or [company_name] support, as this seems likely to be a PC issue rather than a problem with the [product_name] starter kit. You could also try installing it on another PC to see if the outcome changes. Regards, [user_name].
A new question published by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread titled '[product_name] V[version_no], ADD LOGIC MODULE.' Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter difficulties and confusion when [product_name], included with a [company_name] starter kit, launches in demo mode instead of a full version despite being purchased new. Problems especially arise when installing on PCs without CD/DVD drives, leading to uncertainty about licensing and proper installation procedures. Guidance for alternative installation and license activation methods is lacking.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that buying the starter kit will provide access to a complete version of [product_name], with an installation process that is clear and works reliably regardless of PC hardware configuration, including those without CD/DVD drives.
